items.title: Production Design
items.text: Movies, TV shows, webseries and commercials. From concept and pre-vis to blueprints, prop design and creation, budget management, and leading teams of set dressers and carpenters.

items.title: Pre-Vis
items.text: A key early step where a vision becomes a shareable plan. Realistic, artistic or animated (animatic) previsualization, always open to revision.

items.title: Props
items.text: Fabrication across several technologies: blueprints for builders, CNC and laser-cutting files, 3D-printing CAD files, mold making, casting in plastic or silicone, and graphics.
